Tests that streaming requests bypass cache entirely

```c title="C"
#include <assert.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "liter_llm.h"

int main(void) {
    LITERLLMAlefHandle chat_completion_request_handle = literllm_chat_completion_request_from_json("{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Hello\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"gpt-4\"}");
    LITERLLMAlefHandle client = literllm_create_client_from_json("{\"api_key\":\"your-api-key\",\"cache\":{\"backend\":\"memory\",\"max_entries\":256,\"ttl_seconds\":300}}");
    LITERLLMAlefHandle stream_handle = literllm_default_client_chat_stream_start(client, chat_completion_request_handle);
    size_t chunks_count = 0;
    char* stream_content = (char*)malloc(1);
    stream_content[0] = '\0';
    size_t stream_content_len = 0;
    int no_chunks_after_done = 1; /* true by construction: the loop below cannot call stream_next again once it observes done */

    while (1) {
        LITERLLMAlefHandle result = literllm_default_client_chat_stream_next(stream_handle);
        if (result == 0) {
            break;
        }
        chunks_count++;
        literllm_chat_completion_chunk_free(result);
    }
    literllm_default_client_chat_stream_free(stream_handle);

    free(stream_content);
    literllm_chat_completion_request_free(chat_completion_request_handle);
    literllm_default_client_free(client);
    /* suppress unused */ (void)no_chunks_after_done; (void)chunks_count; (void)stream_content_len;
    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}
```
